name: Cozy cottage
about: A little house with a stone base, a pointy roof and a chimney that puffs smoke.

layers.name: Stone base
layers.tip: A ring of cobblestone, 9 by 7, with oak planks inside for the floor. Leave a row empty in front and behind for the roof to hang over.

layers.name: Walls and door
layers.tip: Logs in the corners, planks between, and a gap in the middle of the front for the door. Bricks in the back corner start the chimney. Put a crafting table, a furnace and a barrel inside.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Glass makes six windows: two at the back, two at the front and one on each side.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: Close the wall all the way around, over the door too.

layers.name: Roof edge
layers.tip: Spruce stairs along the front and back, one block out from the walls, with their tall side towards the middle. Planks fill the two ends.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: The next line of stairs, one step in and one up.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: One more step in. The chimney keeps going up through the roof.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: The last line of stairs on each side.

layers.name: Roof top
layers.tip: Spruce slabs along the top. A campfire on the chimney makes smoke.
